summary: The upgrade from Ubuntu 20.04 to 22.04 will involve several toolchain upgrades and may encounter some known issues, particularly for users with specific hardware requirements.

claims.text: The upgrade process is supported for both desktop and server systems, but it requires network connectivity.
Users upgrading from Ubuntu 20.04 to 22.04 will receive all changes that happened in the six months since Ubuntu 21.10, as well as interim releases.
The upgrade process for Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS will not run, install or even boot on POWER8 systems due to the different instruction set requirements.
GCC has been updated to version 11.2.0, and Python now ships at version 3.10.4.
The upgrade process for Ubuntu Server will use GNU screen and automatically re-attach in case of dropped connection problems.
Known issues with this release include significant bugs that users may encounter, as documented in the known issues section.
